label: Preexistence without transfer: where nothing gives what it lacks is load-bearing
summary: Graph. Strict expansion = least fixpoint over verified arguments with statements lacking a verified derivation as leaves (strength-order results and the batch's own 9e7de16d counted; excluding strength orders and 9e7de16d would make distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7 a leaf, and then all 11 routes survive). Removing 376d6a5a left 1 of 10 routes to STMT-GOD-EXISTS (prima via ed7c588a). Granting preexistence 64498e7e still left 1; granting the Metaphysics alpha 'more such' premise d5a94eb1 restored all 10, so the bottleneck is d5a94eb1, whose only derivation uses 376d6a5a. Blockers per route: 5e8e6054, 1c154f2f, 72391d4d, 0a639ec4 only grades-to-a-maximum 6c27657f (uses more such at an arbitrary perfection); 661ce61d, beec1dc1, fd1f7e75 that step, d5a94eb1 directly and (two) moves-only-as-in-act f296a694; 678ff65f d5a94eb1 directly (used only at esse); 92ab7c94 via da3facd6 preexistence and God-is-maximal 4c79298d (whose derivation 482f4ad2 uses more such only at esse). Results (zero axioms, Comparator and NanoDa, countermodel.py omission models for every premise except excluded middle, recast to Bool/Unit): (1) 'a distinct cause of a thing's being is more in being than it' (cffad050), the instance at esse of the formal reading d5a94eb1 (same MoreIn; the synonymous source sense is not claimed at esse; order model of MoreIn esse open, STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH), from 'a cause of being has being' 4ccb319f and the reception bundle, no transfer principle; strength order d5a94eb1 => cffad050 (strict, control 1). (2) God is maximal in being from causing being with cffad050 (4c79298d now available without 376d6a5a). (3) GOD_4 exists from a MAXIME_1 cause of all being with cffad050: new root route 5d2b7c6e that survives removal of 376d6a5a. (4) Preexistence from transfer f8ba2429 and the cause-of-being restriction d0fc96b7; with the existing derivation of d0fc96b7 from preexistence and 'a caused perfection is had' (90e85f77) the two are interderivable given transfer. Every derivation of either bottoms out under strict expansion in 376d6a5a, or cycles through 'more such' d5a94eb1 and distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7. A ground for preexistence needs a ground for d0fc96b7 that is not preexistence, or a ground for 2c0b9bd7. (5) 'More such' with c11369aa entails distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7; (6) distinct-cause transfer with the five-premise reception bundle gives 'more such'. Any route using 'more such' at an arbitrary perfection together with c11369aa is committed to distinct-cause transfer; conversely transfer with the reception bundle suffices for 'more such'. (6) is the sibling of 924302df, which uses 376d6a5a only for distinct causes; strength order 376d6a5a => 2c0b9bd7 (strict, control 3). Survivors after the batch with 376d6a5a removed: ed7c588a and the new 5d2b7c6e; none of the old nine. Positive finding: granting distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7, strictly weaker than 376d6a5a, restores all 11 routes; granting d0fc96b7 adds 92ab7c94. Hypothetical: preexistence available adds 92ab7c94; grades-to-a-maximum available adds the four CONCRETE_6 routes, which pass it to maximumExistsOfNecessaryAt (applied at esse), so the existing esse instance STMT-GRADES-TO-MAXIMUM-AT-BEING may suffice (unchecked for every use). Failed or rejected approaches: (a) preexistence from f8ba2429 plus d0fc96b7, the brief's lead: verified, but it lifts nothing. Every derivation of either bottoms out under strict expansion in 376d6a5a, or cycles through 'more such' d5a94eb1 and distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7. A ground for preexistence needs a ground for d0fc96b7 that is not preexistence, or a ground for 2c0b9bd7. (b) Preexistence from cffad050 plus 'whatever is more in being than x has every perfection x has' (non-causal grading premise): not registered; the premise faces a counterexample from ordinary grades (a human more in being than a bird lacks flight formally, and eminent possession of flight is not obviously available). (c) Decomposing d0fc96b7 into agent likeness (q.4 a.3, unread) plus a likeness-to-eminence premise: not formalized; the second premise risks fixing eminent containment so that it forces the conclusion, and a likeness primitive needs its own definition and grounding. (d) Re-deriving d5a94eb1 without 376d6a5a content: no derivation of d5a94eb1 can avoid content that, with c11369aa, entails 2c0b9bd7. (e) Perfections-are-modes-of-being 791fa216 and total-cause routes: they give causing, not having, so they reach transfer, not preexistence. (f) countermodel.py omission for excluded middle: unresolved (it holds in every model), and certificates with Classical.em were dropped to keep zero axioms. Warrant: 'a cause of being has being' rests on agency in act ef068f46 (no independent warrant recorded) and sourced q.4 a.1 ad 3; two reception premises (cdb79aa6, 39a4c28c) generalize q.7 aa.2 and 1 from esse and are used only at esse, where they correspond informally to q.7's readings 7de89edb and 1304b462 in different vocabulary (unary EsseLimited; reception in a principle), with no registered bridge, so their esse instances are not thereby sourced; the other three (a9036c3c, d0b76fb9, 7030af77) have no source note or recorded warrant; no independent warrant for d0fc96b7 is recorded, and its traditional grounds (q.4 a.2 virtual preexistence, q.4 a.3, SCG I.28-29, De ente c.4) are unread leads, the subsistent-being proof reported, unverified, to apply only to a cause that is its own esse. Objection: strong emergence targets distinct-cause transfer read formally by counterexample, but its independent justification (that strong emergence occurs; Broad, O'Connor, Chalmers) is an unread lead and its relevance to d0fc96b7 needs an open bridge (the emergence base as extrinsic efficient cause of being); it does not bear on cffad050. It does not meet the Substantive Objection Standard yet; the hypothetical only motivates a question of meaning and carries no evidential weight. Pending sense fork within IN_ACT_3 (InActFormallyOrVirtually): substantive eminence versus power-eminence; on power-eminence MoreIn would compare virtual with formal possession (equivocation risk).
blocker: Preexistence 64498e7e still needs a ground for the cause-of-being restriction d0fc96b7 that is not preexistence, or a ground for distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7; the grades-to-a-maximum, moves-only-as-in-act and direct 'more such' consumers on seven routes need either distinct-cause transfer 2c0b9bd7 (content of 376d6a5a minus self-causation) or re-routing through esse instances where they suffice. Next tests: re-route the four CONCRETE_6 routes through STMT-GRADES-TO-MAXIMUM-AT-BEING; annotate or re-route the sixty consumers of d5a94eb1 now flagged by truth check; read q.4 a.3 and SCG I.28-29 for a ground of d0fc96b7 restricted to the root. Also test whether PrimaryCauseIsMoreSuchReading at esse for the maximum or God suffices in place of cffad050 for 5d2b7c6e and the sibling of God-is-maximal.
